title: North Korean Hackers Linked to Record $6.3B Binance Theft
excerpt: Hackers backed by North Korea are suspected of stealing a record $6.3 billion from Binance after compromising an employee's laptop.
body_html:
Cybersecurity investigations have pointed to hackers working for North Korea as the culprits behind a massive cryptocurrency theft. The attackers reportedly targeted a Binance employee's laptop, gaining unauthorized access that enabled the unprecedented heist.

According to reports, the breach resulted in the theft of $6.3 billion in digital assets, marking a record amount for a single cryptocurrency security incident. Authorities and investigators are continuing to examine the specifics of how the employee's device was compromised to facilitate such a large-scale breach.
